create_running_stats_from_list: create a RunningStats instance from a list of numbers to compute running mean and std
update_running_stats_single_value: update a RunningStats instance with a single value using the update method
consume_running_stats_iterable: consume an iterable of values into a RunningStats instance to accumulate statistics
get_mean_and_std: get the mean and standard deviation from a RunningStats instance using the mean and std properties
get_meanfull_with_std_of_mean: get the mean and standard error of the mean from a RunningStats instance using the meanfull property
